entropy_matrix.detection_strategy: Age-bucket queue rows by status and claimed_at/updated_at; alert on running timeout, retryable backlog, dead_letter growth and missing audit transitions.
entropy_matrix.cleanup_repair_strategy: Move timed-out running jobs to retryable, replay dead_letter with advisory lock, cap retry attempts, and preserve replay audit rows.

entropy_matrix.detection_strategy: Track latest successful backup timestamp, verify-backup status, restore dry-run age and checksum drift.
entropy_matrix.cleanup_repair_strategy: Fail readiness when no fresh verified backup exists; rotate old backups only after a newer restore-verified backup is present.

entropy_matrix.detection_strategy: Run referential integrity probes for chunks without versions, files without documents, citations without message snapshots and index rows without live chunks.
entropy_matrix.cleanup_repair_strategy: Dry-run first, delete only provably unreachable rows/files, and require protected counts for historical citations and backup artifacts.

entropy_matrix.detection_strategy: Compare search index document/chunk ids against DB lifecycle state after upload, archive, delete, restore and reindex.
entropy_matrix.cleanup_repair_strategy: Run workspace-scoped reindex, remove archived/deleted stale entries, then verify drift report is empty.

entropy_matrix.detection_strategy: Replay golden citation queries and compare stored citation snapshots against current document lifecycle/source_status.
entropy_matrix.cleanup_repair_strategy: Never rewrite historical quote snapshots; repair missing source_status metadata and keep deleted/archived sources visible as historical citations only.
